definitions.explanation: A written plan prepared by a teacher that outlines the objectives, content, activities, and flow of a class session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教案|きょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared the lesson plan for tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {教案|きょうあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: I conducted the class following the lesson plan.

examples.japanese: {新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{教案|きょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The new teacher spends hours writing lesson plans every day.

notes:
A {教案|きょうあん} is the formal plan a teacher writes before class, detailing objectives, timing, materials, and activities. In Japan, student teachers and new teachers are typically required to prepare detailed lesson plans for supervisor review.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教案|きょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ — to create a lesson plan
- {教案|きょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ — to submit a lesson plan
- {教案|きょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ — to review a lesson plan
- {略案|りゃくあん} — abbreviated lesson plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導案|しどうあん}→指導案：16670_shidouan⟧ — instructional plan (more formal; the official term used in Japanese education)
- ⟦{授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}→授業計画：24023_jugyoukeikaku⟧ — class plan (broader, may cover a full course)
- ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧ — curriculum (the overall program of study)
